answer: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS pct FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');
SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM atom WHERE element IN ('i', 's') AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');
SELECT a.element, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';
SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1;
